steps.name: Ah-kyung’s letter
steps.objective: Go to "Yonggyeong" and talk to Ahkyung.

lines.speaker: 아경
lines.text: Welcome! Thank you for coming here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay. So what do you want to ask for?

lines.speaker: 아경
lines.text: This is a request related to Yongje Castle in Yongjing.

lines.speaker: 아경
lines.text: He said it was okay because he still had energy, but he looked like he was having a hard time.

lines.speaker: 아경
lines.text: I couldn't watch it anymore, so I contacted %s. Even if he scolds me because he is arbitrary, there is nothing I can do about it.

lines.speaker: 아경
lines.text: I've been hearing about %s's activities.

lines.speaker: 아경
lines.text: I decided it was time to need %s's power.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you for your positive evaluation. I wonder what's going on. Could you explain?

lines.speaker: 아경
lines.text: As you know %s… .

lines.speaker: 아경
lines.text: Here in Yonggyeong, there is a huge castle with space isolated by a strong barrier.

lines.speaker: 아경
lines.text: That place is Yongjeseong... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think I remember it, albeit vaguely.

lines.speaker: 아경
lines.text: The name of the space barrier isolating Yongje Castle is probably... .

lines.speaker: 아경
lines.text: [Stopped time]… .

lines.speaker: 아경
lines.text: One of the ‘secret arts of great miracles’ that isolates a designated location from time and space.

lines.speaker: 아경
lines.text: While the barrier is maintained, no one can break in, and conversely, beings inside cannot escape.

lines.speaker: 아경
lines.text: This is because time in the isolated space stops.

lines.speaker: 아경
lines.text: It is a secret art that could only be used by those with outstanding talent among the blood relatives of the ‘Dragon Emperor’ who founded the Dragon Empire.

lines.speaker: 아경
lines.text: But recently, the barrier of this dragon city has been broken.

lines.speaker: 아경
lines.text: As a result, Yonggyeong-gun, which had been trapped in frozen time for 400 years, woke up and began its activities again.

lines.speaker: 아경
lines.text: 400 years… … .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's wrong?

lines.speaker: 아경
lines.text: No, it's nothing. I just felt frustrated... .

lines.speaker: 아경
lines.text: Anyway, Yonggyeong-gun is dangerous. Yongje, who made Yonggyeong-gun like that, became an even more evil devil.

lines.speaker: 아경
lines.text: An emperor who refused to be human because he wanted power, and an army that the emperor forcibly made strong with the power of the devil... . Really... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then we have to stop them.

lines.speaker: 아경
lines.text: Yes, we have to fight against them in Yongje Castle now.

lines.speaker: 아경
lines.text: You can meet him if you go to the red sorghum field that is only visible at night.

lines.speaker: 아경
lines.text: %s I desperately need your help. So, don't turn away and be sure to go to 'Red Sorghum Field (Midnight)'!

steps.name: Resurrection of Yongjeseong
steps.objective: Go to “Red Sorghum Field (Midnight)” and talk to Gendia.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Are you… ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, my name is %s and I came at the request of Ah-kyung.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you by any chance the commander here? The unit fighting against the Yonggyeong Army... .

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: You have listened to some extent.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Yes, I am the commander of the ‘Giandia Imperial Army’… . The name is Gendia... It is said.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Ziendia Empire?

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: The Gyendia Empire used to be a country in the center of the Gyendia continent, but is now quietly continuing its existence on one side.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: The reason I came here was to break off a bad relationship from a long time ago. Bad relationship with the dragon emperor... .

lines.speaker: 제국 정규군 1
lines.text: Your Majesty! Horangsa's Hoseon has just arrived! You have just entered Yongje Castle!

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Hoseon has finally arrived... .

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Soldier, tell the deployed troops. Follow Hoseon Leiray’s instructions and move.

lines.speaker: 제국 정규군 1
lines.text: My name! I will support you!

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Since Ho-seon is here, we should hope that nothing bad happens. Oh, how much did we talk about?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Your Majesty… .

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: You're surprised.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeah, a little… . When I heard His Majesty's name, I thought it was a special name, but... .

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Please treat me comfortably.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: In the meantime, I've heard a lot of stories from %s.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Thank you for taking on many dangerous tasks for the safety of people and peace on the continent. Shall we get to the point now?

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: (As Giendia catches his breath, the feeling of the air flowing around him seems to change.)

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: 400 years ago, the fall of Longjing began with the conflict between Emperor Yong, the ruler of the Longjing Empire, and his son, Prince Kii.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: At some point, the Yong Emperor suddenly turned into a tyrant and attempted to sacrifice Son Qi's fiancée and ally's princess to the devil.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Moreover, they tried to start a war with the intention of conquering all the countries on the Giandia continent. Using the power of the devil... .

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Prince Kii set out to stop his father's tyranny and chose to sacrifice himself. I activated the [Time Barrier] and isolated this place from the current world forever. Even though you know what kind of choice it is for you... .

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: One day, 400 years later, the barrier broke. As if someone did it on purpose... . Seeing Yonggyeong-gun waking up and moving around, I'm sure Yongje has also woken up.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: We have to find out who broke the barrier. And we have to defeat Yonggyeong, including the Yongje, which we couldn't do in the past. That's what I have to do as I live in the confines of time... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Will it take long to break down Yongje Castle? The reason we don’t have enough people is… .

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: That's because many of the Empire's personnel are involved in different operations.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Above all, this is like a personal problem that I have to solve myself... .

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: So, I came to Yonggyeong with only a small number of troops who could move immediately.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It seems like a bit of a difficult situation... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What should I do?

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: I would like to ask you to deal with the Yonggyeong troops defending Yongje Castle. A few elite soldiers infiltrated the castle, but success could not be guaranteed... .

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Of course, I trust our soldiers, but this place requires special human strength. Just like Adventurer... .

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: I would like you to help us deal with the defense forces around Yongje Castle.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will try it.

steps.name: Get rid of anxiety factors quickly!
steps.objective: Defeat [Yonggyeong Army Swordsmen] and [Yonggyeong Army Archers] and report to Gendia.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: … We've received some strange intelligence, and I think you should listen to it.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Prince Yonggyeong, whom we killed during intelligence, had a ‘magic stone’ containing faint magical power.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Magic stone… This?

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: As you know, Yonggyeong-gun is not an ordinary human force. The magic stone you have is probably the cause.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: First, I need to find a magic stone and take a look. Yonggyeonggun needs to find the secret that can give him this kind of power... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A magic stone that strengthens your strength... . What the heck… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, can I collect it for you?

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Please, %s… .

steps.name: strange object
steps.objective: [Elite Swordsman] Defeat [Elite Archers] and retrieve the <Suspicious Magic Stone>.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: This is the magic stone in question... .

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Oh my... , the energy contained in the magic stone is too faint. Is it because the absorption of power has finished?

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: I think it would be difficult to analyze this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If there is a stronger being, wouldn't there be a stronger magic stone?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Could it be… . then… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is there anyone in Yonggyeong-gun that is even remotely strong right now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If such a being exists, I think it would be a good idea to go deal with it and bring it back.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Hmm, wait a minute. Ah, there is such a being.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: They are ‘wild beasts’ in charge of defense on the outskirts of Yongje Castle. They will be twice as strong as regular Yonggyeong soldiers.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: He commands the defense line while riding a wild beast... , The strength of a soldier is strength, but the beast also receives the power of the devil, so you have to be careful.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will be careful.

steps.name: Magic stone pattern study
steps.objective: Defeat the [Beast Soldier], obtain the <Powerful Magic Stone>, and report it to Giendia.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: The magic stone pattern is difficult... . It's hard to know exactly with my knowledge.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: I thought I was somewhat familiar with magic, but the moment I saw this magic stone, I felt like I wasn't.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What exactly is that?

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: This is how the circuit of the magic spell engraved on the magic stone is structured. Basically, when wizards construct a magic circuit... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sorry, but I'd like you to explain it a little easier.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Okay, let me explain again.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: The method of activating the magic engraved on the magic stone is very unique, making analysis difficult.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: I don't think it's a common form... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So what should I do?

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: I think I'll have to ask someone who is familiar with this magic for help.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: If you are Hosun Lei Lei in Yongje Castle... .

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: I'm sure you know something. Then I'll ask you a favor.

steps.name: powerful magic stone
steps.objective: Deliver <Powerful Magic Stone> to Lei Lei in “Dragon Emperor Castle”.

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: Gndia asked you to show this to me? Hmm, what is it?

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: I'm not a magic expert like Jeril, so magic knowledge is a bit difficult.

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: Still, I'll take a look just in case!

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: Let’s see, um… !

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: (Leirei lets out a heavy sigh.)

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: This dirty magic pattern that seems almost impossible to recall... . I'm sure I saw it somewhere, but I can't remember.

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: I think it's because too much time has passed... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that so?

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: Still, I have fresh face. Just wait a moment. Okay. Okay… .

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: It only takes a little bit, just a little bit, so just wait. Just wait a moment.

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: So!!

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: Hey, you help me while I'm looking into this. It's so noisy around here that I can't concentrate. Please help me a little bit.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What can I do?

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: Simple, simple, very simple. All you have to do is chase the bad guys out here. It only takes a moment, while I concentrate. It's so easy, isn't it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, in just a moment... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Suddenly I feel dizzy….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Is it just my mood?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hoseon, I’ll be right back.

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: Ugh, huh. You look bad right now, are you okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I'm fine. We'll buy as much time as possible, so if you know anything about magic stones, please think about it!

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: Okay. So take care of yourself. Okay?

steps.name: While reminiscing
steps.objective: Defeat [Yonggyeong Army Officer] [Yonggyeong Army Spearman] and report to Lei Lei.

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: Phew, I was waiting. Are you okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I'm fine.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The soldiers in Yongje Castle were definitely different. Movements that are different from those of ordinary humans... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who on earth created that magic stone?

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: That… .

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: It's Agashura. The unique magical circuit composition engraved on this magic stone is clearly Agashura. I guarantee it! however… . hmm… . Something is strange.

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: I've seen Agashura's technique before, but it was very different from the normal form. Even the ancestors couldn't touch it. Hmm… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that so? I'm a little suspicious.

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: A power that even the power of good men cannot reach... . Have some faith.

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: A boundary that even other good people cannot ignore... . This is none other than Agashura! Agashura!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. Agashura… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Why on earth did Agashura do something here?)

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: You’re not doubting my skills, are you? Oh, that's right. There's something I couldn't say.

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: Suddenly, Jiendia entered Yongje Castle!

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: He asked me to send you to where he is as soon as you arrive. They said they put a sign up so you can get there quickly.

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: Maybe only you can see it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: When I met you, I probably casted some kind of magic to keep me safe. So don't doubt it!

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: Because Gendia doesn’t want others to get hurt because of him.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Because of someone else? Oh, and I never doubted it.

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: Okay, okay. Then you're going to go to Gndia right away, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, since you were looking for me, I will go.

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: Gndia is a bit complicated. He is a person with many stories.

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: Maybe you can understand.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that so?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then, I will go to His Majesty and tell him exactly what Lei Lei said.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is there anything else you'd like to say?

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: Not right now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… , Then I’ll just convey what you said.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Agashura….)

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: I'm going to stick with the plan as much as possible with the soldiers here, so you have to be careful. Okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will go inside. So be careful.

steps.name: Agashura's Magic Pattern
steps.objective: After talking with [Leirei], go to Jiendia in “Dragon Emperor Castle”.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: I already heard the general story from Hoseon.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Actually, I had some doubts too... As expected, it was an item made by Agashura.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: As expected, Hoseon is a great person! You know this too... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I guess you trust Hoseon a lot.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Of course. Anyway, now that the outline of the culprit who broke the Yongje Castle barrier has been drawn, I think we can solve the problem.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Once you kill the owner of Dragon Emperor Castle, everything will end. Obviously… .

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: There's something I need to take care of before that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What needs to be done?

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: It's very important.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Currently, our troops who entered Wolhwawon are missing.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: I think the construction axis of Wolhwawon was distorted and the road became a mess.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If it's a construction axis... .

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Yes, the barrier is the cause.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Wolhwawon has long been a place famous for being full of clear and rich energy.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: While Yongjeseong was cut off from external space due to the effect of the time barrier, the energy that had been condensing exploded at the same time as the barrier was lifted.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: So I can only guess that construction may have been affected.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: … It was a little difficult, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's a little hard to understand, but can you tell me clearly what I need to do?

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Please check whether Wolhwa Wonju is also affected by Maseok.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: If Wonju is not in his right mind, he should never come out.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: In Wolhwawon, there is a large-scale formation that accumulates external energy... .

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: At the center is Wolhwa Wonju.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Perhaps the 'axis' will collapse and the formation will be dismantled if the Wonju is processed. Then, the erroneous flow of time and space will slowly take root.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wow, you are amazing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How do you know this?

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: I heard it directly from Prince Kii.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Oh, I don't have time. We need to hurry because our troops continue to be sacrificed.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: … So, let me ask you a favor.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: I don't think this situation will be resolved quickly just by dealing with Wonju. I will gather information and find a solution.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I understand.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll be back then, so please be careful.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: I expected it, but Wolhwa Wonju was also controlled by the magic stone... .

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: I feel sorry for you. He was a warm-hearted person who loved flowers... .

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Now that Wonju is gone, the distorted construction of Wolhwawon will soon return to its original state.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: So now we have to go to the starting point of the tragedy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you okay?

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: I'm fine. Then I will tell you the story of Yonghwangjeon. This is the space where the emperor who created this place, or Yongje, resides.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: In order to protect his throne, he was suspicious and afraid of even his own son... .

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: I found Lux, the Lord of the Demon World, and risked my soul as a bargain. A pathetic and unscrupulous monarch who believed that he would become a corrupt dragon and devour everything... .

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: And there is a great man who even sacrificed himself to stop the corrupted dragon.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Prince Kii, you are no longer the crown prince.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: (As Gendia's eyes wander, a soldier comes running from afar with a perplexed expression.)

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: What's going on?

lines.speaker: 제국 정규군 1
lines.text: Your Majesty! Hoseon requested support. It is said that Yongje's army is currently trying to go out, and Hoseon is blocking the way with the remaining troops.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Yes, I understand. %s, I'd like to conclude this conversation and ask you one more favor. Although it is a small country, as the monarch of a country... .

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: The entrance to Yongji City will not be complicated now, so go in and meet the foolish emperor and punish him. And please bring me the magic stone he has.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: In the meantime, I also plan to help Hoseon. We have to end the corrupted dragon to cut off everything that stands on the border of time... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Fallen dragon…, boundary of time…. It’s complicated, but it’s still something that needs to be done….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I will come back.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Thank you, %s… .

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: (Maybe you….)

steps.name: To the starting point of tragedy
steps.objective: Defeat [Tam] in the "Dragon Emperor Hall", obtain <Tam's Magic Stone>, and report it to [Gi] in the "Dragon Emperor Hall".

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: Who is there? Reveal your identity.

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: No, rather, I… .

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: Why am I not dead yet? Most likely, I must use a secret technique handed down in the royal family to stop Abamama from turning into a dragon... .

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: The secret art of great miracles, the barrier of ‘stopped time’ was activated.

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: And I got stuck in there too… . Yeah, I remember.

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: But… , but… Ugh!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Kii is in pain.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, Prince Kii?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you okay? I'd like to give you some medicine... .

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: I'm sorry I didn't receive your favor. This is not a pain that can be treated with medicine... .

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: This is a repulsive force caused by the spirit and body being forcibly separated... . Someone did something like this... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Gii, have you seen those who lifted the castle's barrier and used magic stones?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: According to Hoseon Reirei, it is the Agashura clan's business... .

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: Now, wait a minute. Did you say Giendia? your majesty? So she became emperor?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: As for the time since Yongje Castle was sealed with a barrier... Approximately 400 years have passed.

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: 400 years?! Well, then what about the Yongjing Empire?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, it's gone. Currently, the Gendia continent is ruled by various powers, including the Kingdom of Elias.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He is leading his troops and blocking the path in front of the awakened Dragon Emperor. To prevent the beings inside Dragon Emperor Castle from coming out... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Now that I think about it, His Majesty is over 400 years old...)

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: It's alive. Yes, you are alive and well. Yes, my time stopped, but her time went by... .

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: My father, the tyrant emperor, was obsessed with the delusion that I, his son, would overthrow him. You may have thought that he wanted power by raising an army.

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: Somewhere, he found Lux, the lord of the demon world, and sold his soul. And in return, he gained power and became a dragon of corruption.

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: In the end, it all happened according to Lux's wishes... .  In order to bring Lux to this land, the emperor kidnapped her, his fiancé, Giendia.

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: He wanted to offer her up like a sacrifice on the altar and use her power to appear.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you saying that Your Majesty is of divine blood?

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: I can't say for sure, but I know such a being as a Demigod.

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: Because she, who had the bloodline of a god, was the only one capable of handling Lux, who possessed some of the power of the demon world.

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: By the time I realized this, I was already halfway through my consciousness.

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: I was able to save Gyendia with the help of the guards I considered family... . I never thought I would become someone who could endure a long period of time.

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: Perhaps Gendia... , Gndia… .

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: (Ki Yi, who was casually continuing the story, looks sad.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Gii, then… . What happened next?

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: Oh, I'm sorry. The story has stopped. I had no strength. Even if it had power, it wasn't enough to stop the fallen dragon whose soul was consumed by darkness.

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: At that time, the empire was not normal due to the emperor's tyranny. In the meantime, if a corrupted dragon appears... .

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: I couldn't bear to see that. The sight of our land, where we lived for a long time for the people, collapsing... .

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: The moment the fallen dragon appeared before me, I made a choice. after… .

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: I had hopes that my escort would untangle the tangled threads of fate, but... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Something like that happened... .

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: I miss G&Dia... .

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: I will trust you. So, go to Gendia and tell him. Just like you did, I too will hold on somehow and find a way to return to my original body... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will tell you. Still, please meet me in person later and talk to me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, have you seen someone who has lifted the barrier and imprinted a magic stone?

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: I remembered that question and forgot about it for a moment. sorry. He screamed that he loved being Agashura. Ah, that man’s fierce eyes… . Once you saw it, you couldn't forget it.

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: This is all I remember. Hurry and tell her. It should be helpful... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will. therefore… You must meet His Majesty… .

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: %s, is that really true?

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Really... Is Prince Kii really alive?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, but… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You said that it was a situation where the body and soul were forcibly separated and were unable to find their original place.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And he said that the culprit was a man from the Agashura clan with long red hair and fierce eyes.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Yes? A man with long red hair? Among the Agashuras I know, the only person like that is... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (New Agashura….)

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: I guess I'll have to postpone seeing Prince Kii for a bit. Let me check it out.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Did you bring Tam’s magic stone?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But why do you use the title Tom?

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: It means ‘fallen dragon’ in the language of the Yongjing Empire. It is said that there was a fallen dragon in the past.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah… .

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Show Tam’s magic stone to Hoseon.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Since you know a lot, if you look at that huge magic stone, you will definitely be able to tell us about the unidentified Agashura man.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Agashura man... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, yes. Then, I will go to Hoseon.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Your Majesty’s expression is very complicated….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Why on earth did Lux want to come here...?)

steps.name: analysis results
steps.objective: Deliver <Tam's Magic Stone> to Lei Lei in "Dragon Emperor Castle".

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: Haaaam~! Does it seem like things have ended well and can I go back like this?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Rayray!

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: Ugh, I tried to go back quietly without getting caught by Gendia... .

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: I can't help it. Phew… . %s, what's going on?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why do you look so bothered?

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: First of all, I want to rest after a big job is over... . Anyway, talk quickly. Because I want to go quickly and rest on this boat!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: His Majesty told me to show this magic stone to Lei Lei.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Give the magic stone you brought to Lei Lei.)

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: I heard that Gndia is good at looking at people, or even gods.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh… .

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: What's wrong with you?

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: Things seem strange, are you okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, no.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It seems like an aftereffect of the battle, but I think it will get better if I get some rest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you for your concern.

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: Yeah, really?

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: Okay. Then I'll check it.

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: Hmm… … .

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: This magic stone… . It's strange. Usually, one attribute is given to each stone, but this magic stone not only has the energy unique to the Agashura tribe... .

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: I can feel something from the demon world... .

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: What does this mean? Lux's movements haven't been detected recently. Agashura's magic stone contains the energy of the demon world... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There's something there.

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: Go quickly and tell Gendia. I guess it's not that unusual. It would definitely be a big deal if Lux and another Agashura joined hands.

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: I'll go back and find out what's going on.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: (Jiandia is slightly surprised after hearing Ray Lei’s story.)

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: What kind of Agashura would dare do something like this... .

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Could it be that Agashura, Choen Palm, whom I had only heard about through rumors, did this?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Your Majesty, Choen Palm has already… .

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: (Gendia looks at me with an understanding expression after hearing the short story about Choen Palm.)

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: %s, I understand. Now, as soon as I finish clearing Yongje Castle, I plan to go back and create an investigation team right away.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Can I make a request for something I need?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I need to find a girl named Iris.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Oh, I heard you were looking for Iris sheep.  As I investigate, if I come across any clues to finding Ms. Iris, I'll let you know right away.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Then maybe Kii... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Your Majesty. Then I'll wait for your call.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Thank you, %s. There is a lot of work to be done ahead.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: We have to find the whereabouts of the red-haired Agashura man, and find out what Lux is planning... .

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: I'll contact you soon. Please wait.
